target_system.identity: Wan2.2 I2V A14B LightX2V four-step distilled D, HiF4 quantized D-Q execution
target_system.runtime: Wan22StepDistillScheduler steps [1000,750,500,250], original LightX2V/HiF4 QDQ, effective native operators
target_system.baseline: Frozen dense D-Q for equal model/precision/schedule/hardware comparisons; D-BF16 is a precision control, original undistilled O is a separate comparative model
target_system.explicit_non_equivalence: D-Q, D-BF16, undistilled O, and a full-model BF16/HiF4 deployment are not interchangeable teacher or quality references

primary_scientific_goal: Explain and exploit input-/state-conditioned FFN computational redundancy in the four-step distilled Wan model to obtain real, quality-preserving dynamic FFN sparsity under deployable operator and hardware constraints.
scientific_questions: Where does conditional FFN redundancy remain after few-step distillation, and how does it differ from the original undistilled model under carefully matched input/quantization/operator controls?

Can information available BEFORE costly main W1/FFN0 execution predict a beneficial input-conditioned support/action over the strongest matched static schedule or support, after compensation and overhead?
Does any conditional advantage survive original HiF4 QDQ, BF16 casting, bias, GELU, gate/residual writeback and the student's own full denoising trajectory?
Which error directions propagate into real video degradation, and can a small correction or targeted post-training restore quality without defeating the inference savings?

target_mechanism.policy: At step/layer/expert and possibly token/tile level, a policy depends on actual runtime-accessible activations/conditions and chooses which expensive FFN channels/groups/operations to execute; purely predefined step schedules do not demonstrate input-conditioned sparsity.
target_mechanism.timing_requirement: All support decision inputs, gathering, QDQ, active GEMMs, restoration, correction, scattering and writeback must be inside the deployed cost boundary; post-W1 oracle scores are upper-bound diagnostics only, not deployable selectors.
necessary_comparators: Best matched fixed support/schedule of the same MAC and correction mechanism
Eligible native oracle on the SAME actions to determine whether an input-conditioned policy has real headroom
target_mechanism.formal_distinction: A positive local oracle headroom is not a deployable gain; a trainable predictor is not a dynamic win without measured native action value; a static budget that changes across four steps is still not input-conditioned routing.

existing_joint_acceptance.quality_population: Genuinely new, overlap/hash-audited frozen I2V sources, native free-running four-step sparse student trajectories, same D-Q control and prescribed official metric implementation
existing_joint_acceptance.cost_scope: Original complete FFN boundary including native preparation, activation and weight QDQ, dense/sparse GEMMs, GELU, routing/predictor, R256 or other corrections, layout, gate and residual writeback
existing_joint_acceptance.interpretation: Existing hard acceptance contract, not a proof that any proposed dynamic method already satisfies it; keep hardware-specific timing and main-MAC arithmetic separate.

evidence_hierarchy.proves: Source-reconstructed computation, cost constraints, algebraic identities and counterexamples
Actual input/quantization/operator boundary and matched native correction or action benefit
evidence_hierarchy.not_proves: Free student rollout, official video quality or complete speed

evidence_hierarchy.proves: Native downstream flow response at a fixed matched full-step input
evidence_hierarchy.not_proves: Free student trajectory, official video quality or fresh-source generalization

evidence_hierarchy.proves: Closed-loop student behavior on the evaluated trajectories
evidence_hierarchy.not_proves: Independent fresh-source quality unless the sources and metric audit are clean

evidence_hierarchy.proves: Joint main MAC, full-FFN timing and all three quality axes on frozen independent sources under same deployment

current_evidence_interpretation.UB1: A strong STATIC baseline: historical original formal20 joint performance 50% main MAC and 1.546x FFN, but supplementary20 imaging drop 3.166%; not a passing generalized dynamic method.
current_evidence_interpretation.R11G1: Native final head gradient/byte-replay readiness at fixed step3/block39; not new dynamic selection or quality.
current_evidence_interpretation.R11T1: Matched 20-step existing-R256 local/native-flow objective probe at fixed step3/block39; development flow SSE improves 1.49121% vs frozen UB1 and 1.57387% vs local, misses registered 2% flow gate; not a candidate, dynamic support, free student rollout or official quality.
current_evidence_interpretation.status: No model method currently eligible. Do not re-open closed exact recipes or launch model experiments from this contract.

next_cheapest_mechanism_checks: Offline, using already saved actual-UB1 operands and the full prior rejection ledger, separate fixed step-budget effects from conditional support headroom under the SAME compensation, budget and native writeback; identify an actually new information/action mechanism before any GPU proposal.

For positive headroom only, test the incremental predictive value of PRE-W1 available signals against the best matched fixed policy while fully charging their collection and routing cost. Reject post-W1 oracle leakage.

If conditional headroom is absent, report that particular action family as unsupported and research alternative representations/precision/operation granularity without relabeling static compression as dynamic sparsity.
Use matched original-O vs distilled-D comparisons only in verified common local scopes; current two-image block20 observation does not establish a general distillation-induced sparsity change.
training_policy: Prefer no large retraining; any small post-training is a means to enable deployable dynamic sparsity and must pay its inference overhead. Do not silently redefine the project as full-model distillation or static teacher-flow reconstruction.
